message:
Add automatic CHANGELOG.md updater for the shared workspace.

Seeds CHANGELOG.md with workspace setup / seeded-geometries copy notes,
and adds .github/workflows/auto-changelog.yml to append an entry on every
push (skipping its own chore: update changelog commits).
summary: Add automatic CHANGELOG.md updater for the shared workspace.

Add graphite-brainstorm and pr-review-agent GitHub Actions.
